title: Interview Defense Questions Database for master_cv

questions.title: OntoTab Architecture and Empirical Superiority of Numerical Baselines
questions.question_text: In OntoTab, why did the numerical baseline outperform ontology-enriched verbalizations, and what was your specific methodology?
questions.context: Evaluates candidate understanding of tabular representations vs dense text embeddings (BGE-M3 d=1024), stratified nested cross-validation, and XGBoost optimization.
questions.suggested_approach: Structure answer in STAR format: cite 30,000 records from UCI Credit Default, 5x3 nested CV, 2,000 bootstrap iterations, lead of Activity E01 baseline, R8 numeric baseline 0.5596 AP vs R5 full ontology 0.5069 AP on XGBoost.

questions.title: OntoTab Statistical Significance and Metric Selection
questions.question_text: Why did you choose Average Precision over ROC-AUC for OntoTab, and what did the bootstrap confidence intervals reveal about the hybrid contrast?
questions.context: Evaluates handling of class imbalance (22.12% default rate) and non-parametric hypothesis testing.
questions.suggested_approach: Explain PR-AUC focus on the minority positive class without distortion from true negatives; detail 2,000 paired stratified bootstrap iterations; highlight that hybrid vs numeric contrast (-0.0028 AP) crossed zero.
